title: Grilled Croatian-Style Pork Chops with Grilled Grapes
description: A Whole30 and wholesome compliant recipe that combines the flavors of Croatia with the sweetness of grilled grapes.

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: use a Whole30 compliant smoked paprika

instructions: 2. Season pork chops with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
3. Brush pork chops with olive oil and grill for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145°F.
4. Meanwhile, thread grapes onto skewers and brush with olive oil.
5. Grill grapes for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
6. Let pork chops rest for 5 minutes before serving.
7. Garnish with fresh rosemary and serve with grilled grapes.
